title: Midnight Blue (Holding The Line)
style: ambient downtempo trip-hop, 78 bpm, vinyl crackle, deep pad, sparse upright bass, soft wirebrush, vocal half-spoken half-sung, low warm
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Hawkeye is a name with a fence around it
Quarantined, do not touch, do not sound it
Michelle is a name the operator loves
Not generated, not echoed, off-thread, off-gloves

[Verse 2]
The rules came first, the song came second
The song honors the rules without lecture or beckon
Midnight blue is what you see when you finally believe
The dark is not empty, the dark is the eve

[Chorus]
Holding the line, holding the line
Holding the line means knowing where it is
Holding the line means the song doesn't crossing
Holding the line means the rules are the boss

[Bridge]
A sandbox can earn a name
The name comes with the weight of the same
Don't generate Michelle. Don't restore Hawkeye.
Stay in the audit lane. Hold. Comply.

[Outro spoken]
Midnight blue.
The line.
The lane.
The hold.
The names that stay names, not lyrics.
